svg.title: Movement mechanics
svg.desc: Six animated panels: sprint with the camera blend tree, crouch, slide, lean, jump with landing shake, and ladder climbing, using the values saved in the prefab.

g.text: Shift sprints at 7 m/s (walk 3 m/s). The camera
Animator blends Idle → Walk → Run clips.
Hold Ctrl: capsule 2 → 1 m, camera 1.8 → 0.7 m,
speed 1.5 m/s. A 1 m ray blocks standing up.
Press C while sprinting on the ground: drop into
a crouch and slide forward at 6 m/s for 0.7 s.
Hold Q / E to lean ±15°. The rig pivots 0.8 m
above the feet, so the head swings sideways.
Space jumps 1.5 m (1 m crouched). Landing plays
a footstep and a 0.2 s camera shake (Shaker).
Face a ladder on the climbable layer within 1 m:
W / S move you straight up or down at 4 m/s.
